performance.verdict: Zero-spend day killed leads; 5 overdue deliverables now threaten renewal.

findings.text: Sep 12 recorded $0 spend and 0 leads — a confirmed zero-spend day caused the 84.89% CPL spike and -41.67% lead drop this 7d window.
5 milestones overdue (oldest: Jul 23 renewal closure): phone-match attribution, contact cleanup, dashboard, and August scoreboard decision all unresolved — renewal at risk.
3-day lead signal (Sep 10–12): 1, 0, 0 leads vs prior 3 days (Sep 7–9): 2, 4, 1 — a confirmed downward break, not noise, within a 45-day range of 0–8/day.
GHL shows 99 opportunities created but 0 won and 0 appointments in 28 days — leads arriving but pipeline stalling at intake, not an ads problem.
GBP actions fell 50.79% week-over-week and show 0 for the last 3 days in series — organic visibility collapsing in parallel with paid, suggesting demand-side or profile issue.

suggestions.text: Immediately confirm Meta campaign reactivated after Sep 12 zero-spend day; verify daily budget cap is not exhausted mid-cycle.
suggestions.monday_update: On Sep 12, Meta recorded $0 spend and 0 leads — confirmed zero-spend day that drove CPL up 84.89% over the prior 7-day window. Check that the campaign is active, the billing method is valid, and the daily budget ($27/day average) has not been throttled or depleted. Success is confirmed when spend resumes at ≥$20/day and leads return to the 2–6/day baseline within 3 days (by Sep 16).

suggestions.text: Escalate intake pipeline: 99 GHL opportunities, 0 won, 0 appointments — fix the lead-to-booking handoff, not the ads.
suggestions.monday_update: GHL shows 99 opportunities created in 28 days but 0 won and 0 appointments booked — leads are arriving but not converting to scheduled visits. Audit the contact-to-opportunity workflow with Lily and the new intake hire: confirm call routing, GHL → Flex Dental handoff, and follow-up sequences are live. Success metric is at least 10 opportunities moving to 'appointment scheduled' status by Sep 20.

suggestions.text: Watch GBP — 0 actions last 3 days and -50.79% weekly; confirm profile is not suspended before attributing to demand.
suggestions.monday_update: GBP actions have been zero for the last 3 recorded days and dropped 50.79% week-over-week. Log in to Google Business Profile to confirm the listing is active, not flagged, and that no pending verifications are blocking visibility. Re-check GBP action counts on Sep 16 — if still at zero or declining, escalate as a confirmed profile issue requiring immediate remediation.
